**Which actions from which meetings are still open, and which are slipping?**


> Carrying meeting output forward until it closes. Actions are the highest-mortality artefact in an organisation: they are created in front of witnesses and die in private. The discipline is a single live list, an owner per line, a date per line, and visible ageing rather than a fresh list each week.
